42043.title: Magnus Bantius the Deipnosophist
42043.description: Magnus can argue eloquently between - and during - morsels.

42044.title: Aéd Leamhán, Oracle of Sages
42044.description: Aéd knows every story there is to know about chucking things.

42045.title: Owain o Ywen, Keeper of Lore
42045.description: Owain builds arguments like a confused bird builds a nest; you'll never know which branch they'll take.

42047.title: Brian na gCapallín, Scathing Satirist
42047.description: Brian's poor mouth will get him in trouble some day, and his like will not be seen again.

42051.title: Urbicius Creticus, Graffitographer
42051.description: Creticus will ensure your citizens correctly use the locative case when the dative does not apply.

42052.title: Pyrrhos of Epirus, Ekpyrotic Architect
42052.description: "Through destruction; creation. Through creation; destruction." -- Pyrrhos, Architecting Ataraxia

42055.title: Sophocles of Athens, Agraphian Dogmatist
42055.description: A believer in the esoteric doctrine that all true knowledge is unwritten.

42056.title: Circaeus of Aeaea, Kykeon Culinarian
42056.description: Circaeus can make a bowl of porridge blow your mind.

42057.title: Abdfil, Elephant Handler
42057.description: Now that our Elephant has a handler, it can contribute to the growth of the empire.

42592.title: Fionnbharr, Young Wolf
42592.description: Fionbharr knows a thing or two about headhunting.

42598.title: Dibblorix, Optima Lixa
42598.description: Dibblorix could sell a Roman his own sandals *and* make him think he got a good deal.

42618.title: Collegiate of Aeneas
42618.description: Inspired by Aeneas' voyages as a boy, he hopes to star in a few legends of his own.

43677.title: Uiscarix, Hygiean Fishmonger
43677.description: Uiscarix can provide enough fish to feed even the hungriest smith, so long as they don't mind the smell.

44076.title: Oat Roller
44076.description: Makes the most of the whole grain.

44077.title: Mudlark
44077.description: She's not afraid to get her hands dirty.

44078.title: Sailer
44078.description: Not to be confused for a sailor.

44080.title: Diviner of Dough
44080.description: He finds the path to leavened futures.

44081.title: Prefect of Ochsen
44081.description: This retired camp prefect discovered cattle are better listeners than any centurion.

44082.title: Student of Whey
44082.description: She hopes to be remembered in lactic legend.

44084.title: Obairrix, Full Metalsmith
44084.description: Obairrix is known for arguing with fishmongers, and for eating their entire stock.

44085.title: Piscine Docent
44085.description: Teaches fish how not to swim, guiding them on the path to liquefaction.

44086.title: Tawer
44086.description: Her skill at leathermaking is hard to hide.

44087.title: The Bifurcator
44087.description: Under his watchful eye, few are willing to make unforgivable breeches.

44088.title: Axle Wheeler
44088.description: Her expert engineering allows chariots to withstand the fury of the roads.

44089.title: The Lapidarius Aureate
44089.description: A stony student of Theophrastus' telluric treaties. They have an uncanny knack for striking gold.

44112.title: Vinecrusher
44112.description: A seasoned viticulturist who gets the most must.

44113.title: Saturnine Smelter
44113.description: Often gloomy, but tends to find a silver lining.

44114.title: The Aeolian Modist
44114.description: An enigmatic figure who believes true harmony cannot be achieved through language, only via song.

44115.title: Mellarius
44115.description: Bees and scribes listen to her honeyed words.

44116.title: Marix, Who Knows The Merrows
44116.description: Marix's skill at shellfinding, they say, comes from an accord with the dwellers of the deep.

44118.title: Princeps of Porphyry
44118.description: Her purples have pomp on par with Ninevah and Tyre.

44119.title: Capillary Coiffurist
44119.description: Provides firm Roman roots for noble dreams.

44120.title: Artisan Allsmelter
44120.description: Nothing is constant, all is reducible; this is the lesson of the allsmelter's crucible.

44121.title: Pragmatic Aegis
44121.description: She knows which bits of tradition are essential, and which are merely "nice to have".

44122.title: Hosta Vulpius, Silencer of Song
44122.description: A vicious soul with a predilection for bird murder. Hopefully he keeps his work life and hobbies separate...

44141.title: Cold Presser
44141.description: He cares only for squashing olives.

44142.title: Caustic Renderer
44142.description: Not particularly friendly, but wastes no time chewing the fat.

44143.title: Student of the Shore
44143.description: His deep dives have granted him a few pearls of wisdom.

44146.title: Busy Sprout
44146.description: Helps grains to shoot for their dreams.

44149.title: Maxima Cottius, Upholsterer of Atlas
44149.description: Heracles himself would be proud to lay his head on a cushion of Cottius' make.

44178.title: Prima Quartienus, Master of Quarters
44178.description: She employs a four-part method to keep things organised.

44179.title: Judicious Rigger
44179.description: Puts spare bits of ship to unsparing use.

44191.title: Bailer
44191.description: Tries to keep water on the outside of the ship.

44431.title: Elephant Handler
44431.description: A Tripolitanian experienced with big grey ones could save the Procurator further exasperation.

50287.title: Xeno of Phillipopolis, Hipparchon
50287.description: Wrote the book on horsemanship, and has the saddle-burns to prove it.

50289.title: Laconic Swordsmith
50289.description: A woman of few words and many points.

51278.title: Lygos Exakion, Architectus Eparchus
51278.description: "Strong walls make strong alliances. Brick by brick, let's build a safer empire."

51292.title: Venator of Artemis
51292.description: Hunting food by daylight; catching fish by moonlight.

51321.title: Tullus Caecilius Cornutus, Arval Brother of Insitor
51321.description: A high holy priest of Ceres, who ensures not a single seed is sown on barren soil.

51324.title: Nomadic Herder
51324.description: Wise in the ways of grazers.

51326.title: Rhea Proserpina, Dis Mater
51326.description: Her marriage to Pluto gave her access to the underworld's riches. Or so goes the miner's gossip.

51330.title: Essentialist
51330.description: Draws out the heart of things.

51332.title: Exuperata, Popular Assemblist
51332.description: Puts things together with unparalleled alacrity.

51336.title: Hestian Culinarian
51336.description: Keeps a keen eye on the hearth.

51340.title: Tirechán Ua Aergol, Tireless Tiller
51340.description: A steady hand on the plough; 'til dusk, 'til dawn, 'til death do him part.

51342.title: Palaephaesta, Dextrous Demiurgus
51342.description: Her hands have mastered every known craft, and a few unknown ones too.

51346.title: Hephaestian Polysmith
51346.description: Skilled in every manner of metalsmithing.

51357.title: Sextus Fontinalis, Head of Fountains
51357.description: Quenches flames of destruction with efficient waterworking.

51362.title: Confident Vigilo
51362.description: Encourages vigiles to go where even Vulcan fears to tread.

51366.title: Leonine Ceramicist
51366.description: Gets clay fired up. But not too fired up.

51374.title: Tanisius, Savvy Scrapblanketer
51374.description: Repurposes offcuts to cut off fires.

51378.title: Sublime Herbalist
51378.description: Lavender's clean scent carries a reminder of elysian fields.

51382.title: Humiliore
51382.description: To dirt we shall all one day return. Eat up.

51390.title: Phlebas, Handsome Phoenician
51390.description: Forget the profit and the loss; Phlebas encourages others to look to windward

51394.title: Mico Annius, Unearther of Lodestars
51394.description: Posits that the figures of gods are hidden within the lime; it is sacred work to excavate them.

51402.title: Argent Hand
51402.description: A shining light in the darkness.

51406.title: Prodigious Stuffer
51406.description: Can put every part of the animal to use, in accordance with some divine plan.

51410.title: Ailbhe Giunnae, Fence-Cut Tonsurist
51410.description: A revivalist of the old druidic hairstyles.

51414.title: Thrinacian Herder
51414.description: Once enumerated all the cattle in Helios' herd.

51418.title: Philof, Baitylician
51418.description: Has a thesis that creations of granite can surpass the gods' own craft.

51426.title: Fiachra Dóiteán, Culinary Immolator
51426.description: Prepares unburnt offerings for people and burnt offerings for the gods, and never once confuses the two.

51430.title: Machaire Mac Marta, Lucid Hatter
51430.description: Turns pelts into petasi under conditions of absolute reality.

51434.title: Philon, Baitylologist
51434.description: Working on a thesis that granite is made up of the unsurpassable knowledge of the gods.

51442.title: Urbane Auxila
51442.description: A veteran of the home front.

51446.title: Centonarion
51446.description: Has a legion of tailors under their command.

51450.title: Unerring Bladeworker
51450.description: Crafts swords with a passion that uplifts and inspires.

51454.title: Necroeudaimon
51454.description: Preaches fermentation as a necessary stage of life; which almost makes the smell bearable.

51458.title: O'Buíochas, Master of Unwinding
51458.description: Encourages others to relax; no need to be so high-strung.

51462.title: Tillus Memmianus, Multi-Faceted Tesselator
51462.description: Embraces all of life's variegated pleasures.

51466.title: Materialist Medicus
51466.description: Knows a hundred diseases and a thousand remedies.

51470.title: Aunt Jellification
51470.description: Her culinary masterworks leave observers all aquiver.

51474.title: Alys, Circus Charioteer
51474.description: Makes Diocles look like a beginner.

51478.title: Shapur of Chalcis, Eponian Eques
51478.description: He travelled a long way to find his god, and together they'll ride much further.

51482.title: Gallus Vinicius, the Light Tread
51482.description: Popularises grape-treading to get the blood flowing.

51486.title: Caloric Meter
51486.description: Maintains a temperature below the point of smoking.

51498.title: Amurca Apothecary
51498.description: Turns leftover olive-water into a tasty tonic.

51502.title: Agronomic Aerator
51502.description: Gives her surroundings a great atmosphere.

51510.title: Curdsbreaker
51510.description: Her presence makes bad vapours cease.

51523.title: Tolupist
51523.description: Theorises all objects can be fundamentally reduced to thread.

51527.title: Patanjali, Flavor Lexicologist
51527.description: Knows every possible pairing for any imaginable ingredient.

51535.title: Heracalius, Sage of Panta Rhei
51535.description: Demonstrates flux and fire with crystal clarity. Everything flows - even glass.

51539.title: Cassiteridean Caster
51539.description: Her metalworking techniques hearken back to a bygone age.

51543.title: Chalcolithist
51543.description: Excavates the green teeth of the world.

51547.title: Alberon, Notorious Lyer
51547.description: Speaks only in falsehoods, but holds up a mirror to the truth.

51559.title: Aulus Rannius, Aureate Collegiate
51559.description: Insists on gold's fundamental superiority as a medium of exchange.

51563.title: Panoplian Potterer
51563.description: For a small fee, she'll make things out of spare pots.

51575.title: Madaidhin, Wooly Comber
51575.description: Finds remarkable things in sheep's clothing.

51587.title: Galerius Natta, Prime Prospector
51587.description: Spots hidden marvels in your marble.

51591.title: Lepidius Exoratus, Polylithologist
51591.description: Really well and truly knows his schist.

51595.title: Aprilis, Snail Stirrer
51595.description: Mixes memory and desire, breeding lilac out of death.

51599.title: Glasspoet
51599.description: Breathes a bit of mysticism into the meltingpot.

51603.title: Preeminent Pulveriser
51603.description: A thought leader in the arts of destruction.

51607.title: Camillus Galerus, Artisan Patron
51607.description: "Watching master craftsmen apply their arts is more precious than any jewel."

51611.title: Caelus Isatis, of the Afternoon Break
51611.description: "Life is a series of unrepeating moments. Spend one of those moments at rest, reclining, won't you?"

51623.title: Mimesius Perrenis, Exemplary Semblancer
51623.description: Assists others in becoming their best, most esteemed selves.

51627.title: Gnarly Knurler
51627.description: Will twist anything by request, leaving audiences quite impressed.

51631.title: Moccix. Escutcheological Herald
51631.description: Portends the coming of defend times.

51635.title: Vigilant Baker
51635.description: Steps in to prevent a toast.

51829.title: Filleter
51829.description: Cuts out gills to help others eat their fill.

51833.title: Hygeian Garumedicus
51833.description: Can treat a wide variety of illnesses with the power of fermented fish.

51835.title: Baker Augcrusta
51835.description: Makes loaves good to eat 'til the last crumb.

51837.title: S.P.Q.R.
51837.description: Sausage Purveyor Quirinus Rubellius, to his friends.

51839.title: Prurient Pourer
51839.description: Quenches fires and thirst with expert measures.

51841.title: Knekkfjall of the Crisp Tundra
51841.description: A traveller from far north, bearing an array of crunchy snacks which go great with cheese.

51843.title: Uesuca, of the Holy Terroir
51843.description: Every jug of wine has a history, and Uesuca knows how to spin a vintage.

51845.title: Haughty Phenomenal Saucier
51845.description: Possesses a strange, vinegary sauce which brings out the best in beef.

51847.title: Calchas of Colchis, Avian Auspex
51847.description: "Every bird keeps a secret in its beak. Now, bite deep."

51849.title: Rusa of Knossos, Benthic Ecclesiast
51849.description: "The gods offer us the bounty of the water that we may feast. So come; let us prey."

51851.title: Sartorist
51851.description: Adjusts the fit so the forehead is free.

51853.title: Fashionist
51853.description: Could make half a tunic seem like acceptable streetwear.

51857.title: Festina Lacer
51857.description: A specialist in sandal-tying and securing.

51859.title: Luscious Soaper
51859.description: Extols the virtues of clean living.

51861.title: Breechblanketer
51861.description: Has mastered the art of quenching flames with hardy cloth.

51863.title: Traditionalist Torquatus
51863.description: From a long line of torquists

51867.title: Marcus Coriolan, Thundrous Speaker
51867.description: "Come, behold the toga! By this, and this alone, Rome exists!"

51869.title: Harchebis, High Tonsurist
51869.description: Harchebis' methods hoist hirsute headwear to hedonistic heights.

51871.title: Ceannglan, Healer of Hats
51871.description: Brushes, washes and combs to keep caps clean.

51873.title: Flavius Cerialis, Birrus Buff
51873.description: Believes hoody cloaks are the future of fashion.

51881.title: Horatia Hemina, Alliterative Litterateur
51881.description: Knows that all great books start with great letters.

51883.title: Appius Gagilius Ismarus, Glass Aficionado
51883.description: His cup runneth over with wisdom. Great at parties.

51885.title: Meresamun, Reflective Intellect
51885.description: Speculates that a well-furnished city reflects well on its governor.

51887.title: Pompo Sittius Quadratus, Bisellariorian Collegiate
51887.description: "Thrones worthy of the Capitoline Hill! Just three gold quinarii!"

51889.title: Asteria of Delphi, Apollonian Musagete
51889.description: Asteria's lyrical paeans can even calm the most raging of the maenads.

51891.title: Akhaz, Who Parts Asunder
51891.description: There'll be no chariots of fire under Akhaz's watchful eye

51893.title: Luchta, Ancillary Godguardian
51893.description: A palladion against all the world's ills.

54017.title: Savvy Capsarius
54017.description: Organising a city is easy compared to a battlefield, she thinks.

54048.title: Herb Lorekeeper
54048.description: Gets seeds to thrive outside their native soil.

54056.title: Lavendulist
54056.description: Helps a thousand blossoms bloom, no matter the circumstance.

54058.title: Listing Litster
54058.description: Weld and woad go where she goes.

54336.title: Elephant Handler
54336.description: A Tripolitanian experienced with big grey ones could save the Procurator further exasperation.

54337.title: Elephant Handler
54337.description: A Tripolitanian experienced with big grey ones could save the Procurator further exasperation.

64945.title: Aulus Pecunius Magnus, Patrician Profiteer
64945.description: They say money makes the man; this man makes the money.

64961.title: Agrippina Pontificus, the Divine Fervour
64961.description: Encourages the pot of faith to boil over.

64963.title: Emer, Thumping Advocate
64963.description: "Our governor is the greatest governor! And if you disagree, please notice I have a large stick..."

64964.title: Senuacus, Dousing Dozer
64964.description: Checks all the lamps before going to bed. All the lamps.

64966.title: Iain Thespis, Brightener of Days
64966.description: Iain's antics make great days greater.

68051.title: Aquila Dulcis, Curator Aquarum
68051.description: Aquila keeps all your aqueducts in a row.

71438.title: Gaius Julius Lupus, Castor of Fortunes
71438.description: Knows how to extricate coin from the commons. He's been plotting his rise to power since he was V years old.

71441.title: Brutus Julius Lupus, Pollux of Polities
71441.description: Solves workforce problems with brute force. There's no question of his loyalty... is there?

71517.title: Even Keeler
71517.description: Unshakeable in her pursuit of repair.

71519.title: Naomh Óg, Wave-Sweeper
71519.description: Once assembled a canoe from driftwood in the midst of a sea-storm.

71533.title: Aelia Avita, Tender Tender
71533.description: Her tendency is to attend to tasks that need tending.

71540.title: Tacker
71540.description: Knows which way the wind's blowing.

71546.title: Lars Farsuleius, Wind-Swift Wharfie
71546.description: Perpetually in a rush, whether by wharf or by waves.

71556.title: Irascible Navigator
71556.description: This old salt has no time to waste.

71560.title: Aisling Sídhbe, Of The Wind-Folk
71560.description: Stares storms in the eye and dares them to blink.

71562.title: Caelus Laecanius, Unbreakable Back
71562.description: Soldiers on; despite it all, through it all, past it all.

71569.title: Deep-water Dredger
71569.description: Grabs the good stuff before it can be dragged below.

71571.title: Gastraphetus, Ballistic Brave
71571.description: Draws the string back without drawbacks.

71579.title: Secunda Alesia, Trenchant Ballistist
71579.description: Reliably gets right to the heart of matters.

71581.title: Projectile Polymath
71581.description: Victory is but a stone's throw away with him on board.

71587.title: Osmuinn, Tathlum-Bearer
71587.description: Holds a stone made from the blood of her foes.

71595.title: Menaechmus, Parabolic Plotter
71595.description: Sees every possible path a thrown stone could follow.

80494.title: Cermaid Mac Ealadha, Dagda's Goodman
80494.description: His cauldron's always full, and his welcomes are always generous. He's a good man for a goodman.

82419.title: Cabin Cleanser
82419.description: Spending time with bandits aboard a haunted wreck taught him the value of cleanliness.

82777.title: Mad Cook, Favourite of Moguns
82777.description: They say he enlightened the Teutons with culinary arts.

83553.title: Philanthropic Patron
83553.description: Formerly of the Honorata's Collegium for Manumission and Liberty; now yours.

88062.title: Barley-Shaker
88062.description: Fair winds have blown him from Cnocnees to your domain.

90573.title: Natanhael Sithar, the Star Diver
90573.description: Telling the fantastic stories of the many marvels he found when diving in the seas.

92874.title: Titus Faber, Master of Tasks
92874.description: Behind the Liberti's efforts, you may find Titus' efforts.

92878.title: Equestrian Trainer
92878.description: Ensures the equites never let their military discipline slip.

92880.title: Herius Fraucus Cornelius, Patrician Palatine
92880.description: Insists there's more to Patrician life than lecti and lunches.

92882.title: Mercurial Marketeer
92882.description: Claims to work three days per day using an arcane calendar.

92884.title: Belmaglo Atrius Leo, Noble Nominator
92884.description: Promises noble rewards for Noble deeds.

92886.title: Uassoro, Neck-Deep Wader
92886.description: Others follow his example to enthusiastically get stuck in.

92888.title: Stalwart Smith
92888.description: Skilled in the arts of smithing, scheduling and swigging.

92890.title: Aedela, Alder Than Alder
92890.description: They say she saw the first day the Romans set foot in Albion, and that she was old even then. True or not, she certainly hasn't let age slow her down.

93989.title: Aisling, Ollamh of Shadow
93989.description: One of Voada's own storytellers. Her comic tales of derring-do could lift even the stoic warrior-queen's spirits when she was feeling low.

94567.title: Aodhan, Master Lutist of the Scathach
94567.description: No one plucks the lute like Aodhan of the Scathach.

95403.title: Servia Bellia, Lily of the Coast
95403.description: A loyal servant of the Turans of Lilybaion. Valeria trusts she can help you out.

96815.title: Gigantulas, Polyphemian Captain
96815.description: Captain Gigantulas is a towering titan of command. With voice like thunder and gaze like steel, he drives ships to glory on wind and wave.

96817.title: Apion Mochthos Apicius, of Apeiron Appetite
96817.description: Apicius was born to sample every delicacy in the Empire. His palate is refined; his recipes are even better.

96819.title: Virtuous Volunteer
96819.description: Driven by duty, not coin. Inspiring.

96821.title: Publius Quintus, Amphipraetorian
96821.description: Publius Quintus embodies praetorian discipline. The mere threat of his presence commands order, efficiency, and dedication to duty.

106412.title: Adept Troughtender
106412.description: Can bring a horse to water and suggest it drinks.

106414.title: Gygaea of Megaria, Eupalinian Reservist
106414.description: Follows the creed of Cretan aqua-artificers.

106541.title: Threefold Defender
106541.description: His triple-pronged defence upholds the worthy.

106545.title: Watchful Villicus
106545.description: None shall breach the walls while he's watching.

106547.title: Vengeful Villicus
106547.description: She will not forgive any trespass.

targets.asset_pool_title: Sheep Farm, Pig Farm in Latium
Sheep Farm, Pig Farm in Albion

106644.title: Divergent Factor
106644.description: She knows how things are usually done; she just doesn't care.

106646.title: Ironclad Distributor
106646.description: Solid, stout sorts of sorter are his standard.

106648.title: Reappraising Codifier
106648.description: His opinions on proper storage are particular.

106652.title: Primus Tremellius Valens, of Towering Ivory
106652.description: Only the most elite, most practiced, most adept in the arts of defence may grace his walls.

106654.title: Cranncriomhthann, Oaken Nonagenarian
106654.description: Stands in defence of the past, for the sake of those who will inherit its future.

106706.title: Cathubodua, Battle-Crow
106706.description: Cathubodua's arrow volleys resemble flocks of carrion birds descending; and when she's done, they soon will.

106710.title: High-strung Conductor
106710.description: Searching for a release of tension.

106712.title: Farah, Iconic Emissary
106712.description: Has commissioned likenesses from Hibernia to Parthava; masterworks, every one.

106714.title: Abiding Closehauler
106714.description: Sails into the wind, literally and metaphorically.

106736.title: Clarion Caller
106736.description: His calls to action are compelling.

106740.title: Equitable Trainer
106740.description: A friend to men and an ally to horses.

106742.title: Hasdrubal, Pedagogic Authority
106742.description: His training plans produce better, brighter warriors in just a few brief lessons.

106844.title: Centurio Chirotheca, Ship's Cat
106844.description: Only the most valorous mariners are permitted to pet this marvellous mouser.

109532.title: Devoted Brother of Herakles
109532.description: All thoughts of Diana were forgotten at Neptune's touch. His attentions are now squarely focused on you.

121725.title: Gan Ye, Envoy to Haixi
121725.description: He has travelled past the edge of the world to see the wonders of Daqin.

121727.title: Serican Smuggler
121727.description: The road of silk has led him here.

125560.title: Abuccus
125560.description: If one has to live with tax fraud, the very least one can do is make sure it's properly organized.

140338.title: Cursory Bursarius
140338.description: Believes money ought to do as money pleases.

140344.title: Inflammatory Flamincia
140344.description: Argumentative? Certainly. But through fury comes faith.

140355.title: Whataboutist Watis
140355.description: Leaves nothing unquestioned. Even questioning itself? Even questioning itself.

140388.title: Ascendant Endorser
140388.description: His star is on the rise. He'll happily bring you along with.

140403.title: Roasted Roustabout
140403.description: He's seen three or four fires too many, but shall not venture a fifth.

144840.title: Abeer, Sirdar of Scents
144840.description: His aromas announce his arrival in advance.

144850.title: Grape Picker
144850.description: Reds in the pot, greens in their basket spot.

144852.title: Gisella, Wine Whisperer
144852.description: Swears that conversing with the vines makes for better grapes.

144854.title: Flaxcutter
144854.description: The waves of a flax field in full bloom; the only ocean he could ever care for.

144856.title: Menna, Field Overseer
144856.description: Work well and he pays well. Slack off, and, well…

144858.title: Samphirer
144858.description: Yes, you actually can eat what she offers.

144860.title: Léire, Queen of the Saltfoots
144860.description: Neither kings nor emperors will deal in her dreadful trade.

144862.title: Resin Harvester
144862.description: They call him "Sticky Fingers" for a reason.

144864.title: Búri, Who Knows The Past
144864.description: Collector of resin specimens; a thousand amber lenses into history.

144866.title: Olive Reaper
144866.description: Her skincare routine consists exclusively of olive oil.

144870.title: Tiny Miner
144870.description: Her cheeks are stubbled with flakes of tin.

144872.title: Orating Lodepicker
144872.description: Always propitiates his patron before prospecting. It seems to work.

144876.title: Lucky Washerwoman
144876.description: Nuggets keep turning up in her laundry.

144900.title: Olympiodoros, Oleaster-Gifted
144900.description: Cultivated the metaphorical grove over the fence in which the olives are greener.

145236.title: Kingfisher
145236.description: His net worth is measured in fish.

145238.title: Tidefarmer
145238.description: It's a lugubrious line of work.

145240.title: Carapacer
145240.description: He collects sea shells by the sea shore.

145242.title: Seasoned Snatcher
145242.description: Catches fish by noodling, and has the scars to show for it.

145244.title: Cuddly Herdmaster
145244.description: Life isn't just about ponies. But they sure help.

145246.title: Salty Slurper
145246.description: Moody if he isn't working; and so work he does.

145248.title: Ruthless Aviarist
145248.description: There is only one fate for her little chirpers, and she knows it.

145250.title: Dubious Dambreaker
145250.description: Every failed hunt gnaws at her.

145252.title: Chiseled Cutter
145252.description: His chiseled cheekbones, they say, could cut granite.

145254.title: Marvellous Sculptor
145254.description: As soon as he lays eyes on a marble slab, he knows what it wants to become.

145256.title: Fausta Festinia Foetida, Domina of Fragrance
145256.description: No perfume can mask the inexpungable stench of her fishy family business. Few are brave enough to bring it up.

145258.title: Iélassu Ma'Rine, The Gaulish Fury
145258.description: Her husband sells the freshest fish. Prepare to have snails hurled your way if you claim otherwise.

145260.title: Asherah, Walker of Seas
145260.description: In her dress of seashells, she strides through the waves, as graceful as a swaying tree.

145271.title: Attendant Graver
145271.description: The black glass sings to him; sings of the shape it will be.

147974.title: Piecemeal Ludologist
147974.description: Assembles the rules of play according to her theory of fun.

147976.title: Lucia Bella, Someday Sibyl-To-Be
147976.description: She sees a future painted in black glass, of gold and Vulcan's glory. And she has never once been wrong.

147978.title: Volesus Carusus, Fearless Earthdelver
147978.description: Game by game, move by move, he plots his escape from the underworld. When he gets there, he'll be ready.

41350.title: Dorian, Philos of Philhellenes
41350.description: He who has a heart of gold does not mind winning silver. Once a Panhellenic athlete, the first of the brothers of Herakles now adorns your city.

41351.title: Licia Ma, Trader of Silk and Secrets
41351.description: Like the phoenix, Licia will always rise again resplendent. But will there be room for her to spread her wings?

41352.title: Tarragon, Whose Voyages Have Ended
41352.description: His journey has one last destination, but he's in no rush to get there. In the shadows of your villa, perhaps he will find his peace, for a time.

41353.title: Zara Nitu, Queen of Mesopotamia
41353.description: Zara has sacrificed her precious solitude and followed her stars into your employ. The mysteries of the universe are multifold. Just follow the trail of entrails.

41354.title: Concordia, Ashen Vestal
41354.description: Concordia's faith still burns with fervour, yet the fire has dimmed. She trusts that you will yet carry Vesta's torch now, that all may be warmed at Her hearth.

boost_details.hint: Earnest in her devotion to the gods

41355.title: Athr Iorgwyn, Once-And-Former King
41355.description: Puppet once more, this king now dances at the end of your strings. Is this his grand finale, or merely an ignoble interlude?

boost_details.hint: Wishes for all tensions to cool down

41360.title: Neferneru, Lion In Waiting
41360.description: The river of Neferneru's passions may some day break its banks and flood forth once more. But for now, while the levees hold, your interests are his interests.

boost_details.hint: Respects those who clearly display their value

42046.title: Zeno Salvia, Collegiate of Rex Infernus
42046.description: Zeno's burial society ensures most lowly can find eternal rest - for a fee...

42048.title: Aisling ui Democritus, Hermeneutician
42048.description: Translator, mediator and interpreter; Aisling helps bridge the gap between worlds.

42049.title: Actorius Maximinus, Nummularius Nonpareil
42049.description: An expert navigator of the Empire's labyrinthine currencies, Actorius can make sure your money gets its money's worth.

boost_details.hint: Not cut out for life in a small village

42050.title: Menander of Nicomedes, Auspicious Haruspex
42050.description: Menander finds good tidings in the most visceral places.

boost_details.hint: More accurate readings from local beasts

42053.title: Basileios of Athens, Epicurian Demagogue
42053.description: Basileios believes life itself is the most special of occasions; eat, drink and be merry while we may.

42054.title: Aquila Dulcis, Curator Aquarum
42054.description: Aquila keeps all your aqueducts in a row.

boost_details.hint: Seeks the most prestigious of Islands

42617.title: Connmhach, Bodhrán Beater
42617.description: Romans and Celts alike can row to the beat of Conn's drum.

boost_details.condition: At least 3 modules on the ship

42619.title: Cantabricus IV, Hegemon of the Seas
42619.description: Cantabricus' favoured battlefield is the ocean; no fleet can stand before him.

boost_details.condition: Diplomacy with Caeso Regulus Syracus: Alliance

42623.title: Dacianus, Prolific Urinatore
42623.description: An expert in plumbing the depths.

boost_details.hint: Follows those who follow of Neptune

42625.title: Merypath, Gromatic Surveyor
42625.description: Merypath cut her teeth on the desert roads in the Empire's south. Her knowledge goes beyond surface detail.

boost_details.hint: Yearns for the loneliness at sea

50890.title: Favillus, Survivor of Sands and Sandals
50890.description: Once a mysterious fighter of the arena, now a force of industry. Where he stands, labor thrives and hammers never tire.

51280.title: Privatus Ouvido Naso, Civic Elegist
51280.description: "Yes, yes, I'll sing your praises and praise your marvels. Just, please, give me some peace and quiet!"

51282.title: Casponia Casta, Sacerdos Cereris
51282.description: "Ceres dwells in every seed, walks in every field. Come; I will show you divinity in a handful of grass."

51284.title: Marinus of Sidon, Meridian Cartographer
51284.description: "The first rule of cartography: keep your lines straight. The second rule: always know where your stylus is. And the third -- take no prisoners."

51286.title: Faustus Silvius Lupicinus, Apparitor Rationibus
51286.description: "You know, the tributum soli was never really terribly well defined in the law. Why, one might even say that the Emperor ought to be paying *you*..."

boost_details.hint: Values good standing with the powerful

51288.title: Euphrosyne Patuleia, Plebeian Suffragist
51288.description: "I call upon the women of Rome to join me - our aim is not to break with tradition, but to make it anew, that all may stand together!"

54025.title: Tiarnan Tine, the Fire-Forged
54025.description: From the fields of Albion, the sands of Kashta;  from Syrah's backrooms to the arena's floor. He's seen it all, and he'll hammer that lesson home.

boost_details.condition: Diplomacy with Caeso Regulus Syracus: Peace
boost_details.hint: Willing to do business with Syracus

54034.title: Íde Nimh, Bane of Pugilists
54034.description: Her poisonous deeds in the arena provoked scandal. Her herbal panaceas provided a cure.

boost_details.hint: Likes a well-stocked cabinet of herbs

54041.title: Mamercus Albanus, Champion of Justice
54041.description: His body was once like steel, and fire ran through his blood. Now retired, he prays other blades can do his work.

71521.title: Déaglán Donnchadh, Gaothoir Órga
71521.description: "Every plank in every ship remembers the tree it once was. They need but the smallest of reminders..."

71527.title: Keincaled, Hardy Buck
71527.description: She's taken a few knocks, and by Jove, she'll surely take a few more.

71535.title: Íosa Ó Iona, Invincible Adamantine
71535.description: Can repair anything with crazed fervor. Just don't insult her hair.

boost_details.hint: Is a favourite of the emperor...

71548.title: Copia Abundantia, The Virtuous And Prosperous
71548.description: Wealth and fortune are the winds that fill her sails. Your sails now, too.

71550.title: Paullus Julius Frigoris, Man Out of Time
71550.description: "We can always get more crew, but we can't get another package! So move!"

boost_details.hint: Wants their ship to be special

71564.title: Shuemsaf, Beloved By the Wind
71564.description: Guided by warm, gentle winds. Calm under pressure, and swift by sea.

71577.title: Magnus Pompeius Magnus, Princeps Nauarchus Maximus
71577.description: "Our fleets are girt with weapons. Stop quoting laws, start surrendering."

boost_details.hint: Motivated by a steady flow of income

71585.title: Calydon Deiranira, Arcadian Archer
71585.description: Artemis guides her arrows; she never misses the mark.

boost_details.hint: Wants all the weapons on deck, thank you very much.

71593.title: Caemgen Sciathóir, Wielder of Blades
71593.description: Stalwart guardian of Brettanogh, master of sword and sail. Baffles enemies with lightning-swift attacks.

79629.title: Captain Achab of the Miolmór
79629.description: A blind obsession drives him ever onward, over the horizon and back again, an unswerving, unending pursuit.

79631.title: Cuilionn Ní Aife, Formerly Of The Scathach
79631.description: One of Voada's loyal maritime ravagers, 'til one day she turned her cloak. It is the one story she refuses to tell.

boost_details.condition: Diplomacy with Voada Of The Scathach: War

79636.title: Herius Asina Restitutus, Intraempire Internuncio
79636.description: He's seen every corner of the Empire, and built a ship in every one. And the Empire has many, many corners...

boost_details.hint: Likes having Trade Rights wherever possible

79927.title: Philosophokles, Eurekean Epigonoi
79927.description: Scion of a long line of philosophokers. Best to keep some spare towls around, lest he be gripped by bathtime inspiration.

boost_details.hint: Prefers coming up with new ideas in the bath

79947.title: Minas Órlámh, the Gilted Touch
79947.description: Her auric sensibilities prove auspicious for voyagers of the abysm.

boost_details.hint: Works best in presence of extreme wealth

79958.title: Lar Syracus, Minedriver
79958.description: His nomen carries a certain menace... but he claims no relation.

80176.title: Publius Aelius Adrian, Balustrian Builder
80176.description: His plans for a great palisade in Albion were scuppered due to a startling lack of dry land.

80179.title: Brian of the Many Blessings
80179.description: He's not much of a savior, but he's a nice sort of lad.

boost_details.condition: No patron god assigned to this island.
boost_details.hint: Follows the correct amount of gods

80189.title: Aneirin Gwawdrydd, Smith Weard
80189.description: Walks the pathway to abilities some consider to be unnatural.

80192.title: Canus Praecilius Thrax, Sociable Syndexioi
80192.description: All sorts of doors can open if you know the right handshakes.

boost_details.hint: Gets overwhelmed with too much to manage

80225.title: Pwyll fab Manawydan, Rhiannon's Postilion
80225.description: A god of the horse needs someone to mind her chariots, Pwyll says.

80490.title: Vel Moderatius, Shaper of Testaments
80490.description: His architectural vision is anything but moderate. But where there is no vision, people perish.

boost_details.hint: Considers the fruit of Knowledge the sweetest of all

80502.title: Cattín, Apothegmatic Apothecary
80502.description: Her words are as well-chosen as her remedies.

boost_details.condition: Diplomacy with Voada Of The Scathach: Peace

80510.title: Zorsines, Sarmatian Swordshaper
80510.description: The secret shape of his swords surprise and stupefy even the sharpest eques.

boost_details.hint: Feels safe in the company of cavalry

80677.title: Potita Calavia Flaminia, Vulcan's Augur
80677.description: When Vulcan's hammer strikes the anvil, it ripples through the world, but only Potitus can hear it.

80686.title: Pericles, Brother of Heracles
80686.description: He once deadlifted a temple... that's what he tells the girls, anyway.

boost_details.hint: Wants to see an Amphitheatre one day

91415.title: Judoc Daidalos, of the Myrtle Tower
91415.description: High alone in his lonely tower, he watches the world go by. History is a nightmare from which he is trying to wake.

boost_details.hint: It would take fifty bells to awaken him

91417.title: Arruns Spedius Fastus, Sutor Supra Crepidam
91417.description: If Zeno's Achilles ever hopes to catch the tortoise, he will need the finest of footwear to split the infinite.

boost_details.hint: Requires three subjects to dress up

91419.title: Síocháinri Bíchearb, Boioran Rhapsodist
91419.description: A lyricist whose voice, they say, was made in heaven; guaranteed to blow your mind, any time.

boost_details.hint: His life is a poem of never ending verses

91421.title: Troucotouto, Subjugating Subiudex
91421.description: Has heard of such things as "time off" and "lunch breaks", but certainly doesn't believe in them.

94541.title: Finnegan, Shadowbrought Scion
94541.description: Once of the Scathach, once of the gens Cornelia. Now, he's not sure what he wants to be. But he wants to find out.

boost_details.hint: Works hardest when surrounded by defences

94555.title: Scipio Thrasea Albionicus, Praefectus Classis Veteranus
94555.description: Led old Emperor Servius' fleet to victory in the last conquest of Albion. Primus Cornelius dragged him out of retirement to conquer the seas once more.

106416.title: Flesc Mac Nechdainn, Well of Wisdom
106416.description: "All divinities spring from the same source. Draw from the well, draw them all in..."

boost_details.hint: Haunted frequently by nightmares about fires

106543.title: Fronto of Lepcis, Adynatic Acropolician
106543.description: Defying even exaggeration, his defences are as indelible as his hyperboles.

boost_details.hint: Sees through the darkness like an owl

106716.title: Amulius Ignius Serranus, Thysdrian Praetor
106716.description: His career has taken him past Carthage, through the Mare Nostrum, beyond Scylla and Charybdis. Where next?

106841.title: Optio Principalis Nico, Capturer of Motion
106841.description: A student of the kinematic sciences. He's seen every move the soldiers make thousands of times.

boost_details.hint: Appreciates islands with a high Happiness

106956.title: Amyntas of Taxila, Taxtaker Emeritus
106956.description: Drawn across the eastern border by the spectacle of the Amphitheatre. Can turn events into opportunities, and opportunities into profit.

106974.title: Sceilg, Eremitic Reductionist
106974.description: Wishes for all the world to leave him be; or most of it, at least.

boost_details.hint: Even a village is too crowded for him

106979.title: Ahumm of Sidon, Naumachian Champion
106979.description: He leads a crew of Naumachian survivors; they make the best swimmers, he says.

boost_details.hint: likes his ship to be well-armed

107337.title: Senchaid Sciatharglan, Ensconced Escutcheon
107337.description: If the Emperor ever comes to Senchaid's gate, he has prepared a dreadfully pointed welcome...

boost_details.hint: Wants to challenge the Emperor in combat

107338.title: Agesistrata of Perga, Lithoballistic Scholar
107338.description: Wrote the book on siege engines; several, even. She's still working on the fourth volume.

107339.title: Aun, Proselyte of Mars Loucetius
107339.description: The sparks of the forge, the lightning-flash of battle, the glory of victory; Aun offers them all to his new god.

107554.title: Lucia Sophus, Imperial Occultist
107554.description: Did you know the Emperor was made in the image of the Monad to banish unlawful demiurges from the realm? Lucia does.

107596.title: Ahinadab, The Eternal City's Praefectus
107596.description: His shadow douses flame, his touch cures ills and his gaze scatters malcontents.

144842.title: Lorana, Herbalist of Fable
144842.description: No matter the hurt, she has the herb.

144844.title: Coileán Peucag, Catcher of the Rainbow
144844.description: It is no exaggeration to say he would die for a good dye.

boost_details.hint: May her tap never run dry

144848.title: Gaius Critonius Ligneus, Warden of the Woods
144848.description: They say he's got a wooden smile. They say that saplings sprout in his wake. They say he lends out firewood...  and can get it back

144874.title: Caderina, Of Extraordinary Prospects
144874.description: Picks the right spot to strike with perfect precision.

144878.title: Aulus Aurius Aureus, Auric Auk
144878.description: "Don't ask what you can do for denarii, ask what denarii can do for you! That's the winner's mindset!"

boost_details.hint: Needs to see a collateral deposit

145262.title: Cutlera, Fastest Blade in Rome
145262.description: Knife goes in, guts come out. Stand aside, or they might be yours.

boost_details.hint: Wants to see the province map sliced with many lines

145265.title: Colmcapaill, Pinion of Pony Pedigree
145265.description: They say a horse raised by his forebears rose to the rank of Consul.

145268.title: Orphelia, Orator of the Long Dark
145268.description: Long has she wandered the tunnels below Occasus. She knows every rock by name, and and sound. And who knows what else she's found?

149281.title: Verconus, Potentiate Widener of Gyres
149281.description: Eyes open to any projectile possibility, Verconus strikes from angles previously unseen.

149292.title: Ancharia, Darling of the Lares Compitales
149292.description: From the cradle to the grave, from the workbench to the dinner-table; Ancharia makes every household feel blessed.
